--autocrop:
Automatically trims uniform borders before conversion. BLACK_TB removes black bars above and below; BLACK checks all four sides. FLAT_TB and FLAT also consider flat-color borders. Leave at default to retain the original framing.

Available choices in your installed IW3: BLACK_TB, BLACK, FLAT_TB, FLAT.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--batch-size:
How many inputs the depth model processes together. Larger values use more memory and may improve throughput; they do not add detail. A single-photo run may see little benefit. Enter a whole number; IW3 documents 1–64. Low VRAM mode overrides batching.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--compile:
Tries to optimize the model using PyTorch compilation. It can add startup time and is not supported equally on every model or device. It does not make the depth estimate more accurate. Leave at default unless testing speed.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--convergence-mode:
Chooses how the screen-depth position is determined. constant uses your Convergence number. sod_v1 uses an additional automatic convergence model. This changes depth placement, not the accuracy of fine object outlines; the automatic model may need installed weights.

Available choices in your installed IW3: constant, sod_v1.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--disable-amp:
Turns OFF automatic mixed precision, which normally uses lower-precision arithmetic where supported to save memory and time. Enable this only to troubleshoot precision problems. It may increase memory use or processing time and does not guarantee better detail.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--disable-exif-transpose:
Turns OFF automatic rotation from a photo’s orientation metadata. Usually leave at default so portrait photos remain upright. Enable only if orientation metadata is incorrect and you intentionally want the stored pixel orientation.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--edge-dilation:
Edge Fix expands foreground areas in the depth map to reduce border artifacts. Enter two whole numbers separated by a space: horizontal then vertical, for example 2 1. One number applies to both directions. 0 disables that direction. Larger values may reduce some edge defects while enlarging objects or reducing depth precision; they cannot recover missing hair strands.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--gpu:
Selects the computing device. On the Mac, leave blank to let IW3 choose. 0 selects the first available accelerator when supported; -1 requests the CPU, which is usually much slower. Multiple numbers are for supported multi-device systems, not extra power on a single Apple GPU.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--inpaint-max-width:
Caps the width used for hole-filling results. Enter a width in pixels. A lower cap can reduce work but may reduce detail in reconstructed areas. Only matters when the selected stereo method uses inpainting. Leave blank for the installed default.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--inpaint-model:
Chooses the model that fills areas exposed by moving the two eye views. Type an exact installed model name. Inject Z uses light_inpaint_v1 when this field is blank. Other models depend on the installed IW3 version and weights; the control’s accompanying IW3 description identifies its model configuration. This fills gaps, not errors in the depth map itself.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--ipd-offset:
Adds a horizontal separation offset to the eye views, expressed as a percentage of image width. This changes viewing scale/convergence rather than teaching the model more accurate depth. 0 leaves it unchanged. IW3 describes 0–10 as a reasonable Full SBS range; start at 0.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--keep-aspect-ratio:
Keeps the original shape of the image when output resizing is requested. Enable to avoid stretching. It only matters when output-size limits cause resizing.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--limit-resolution:
Prevents the depth-model input from being enlarged beyond the photo’s own resolution. This is a cap on depth analysis, not a limit on the final stereo image size. Enable to avoid analyzing an upscaled small photo; leave default for IW3’s normal behavior.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--low-vram:
Uses a low-memory processing mode and disables normal batching. It may help with memory errors, at the cost of throughput. It does not improve depth accuracy. On your 64 GB Mac, leave at default unless memory is a problem.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--mapper:
Advanced mathematical remapping of depth before stereo generation. Different mapping curves distribute separation differently between near and far areas. Accepted names depend on your installed IW3 version. Usually leave blank and use Foreground Scale instead; a wrong name will be rejected by IW3.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--mapper-type:
Selects the family of mathematical remapping used with Foreground Scale: div is division-based, mul is multiplication-based, and shift is shift-based. These change the depth curve rather than recognizing objects more accurately. Their effects depend on the depth model and scale value. Leave at default unless comparing mapping behavior.

Available choices in your installed IW3: div, mul, shift.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--mask-inner-dilation:
Adjusts expansion of the inner mask used by the inpainting stage. Enter a whole-number iteration count; 0 leaves this adjustment off. Changing it changes which pixels participate in repair. Only applies to compatible inpainting methods; try small changes on a sample rather than assuming larger is better.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--mask-outer-dilation:
Adjusts expansion of the outer mask used by the inpainting stage. Enter a whole-number iteration count; 0 leaves this adjustment off. A broader repair region may alter more surrounding pixels. Only applies to compatible inpainting methods; it is separate from depth Edge Fix.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--max-output-height:
Caps the finished stereo image height, in pixels. This changes output size, not the depth model’s analysis resolution. Leave blank to avoid an explicit height cap.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--max-output-width:
Caps the finished stereo image width, in pixels. Remember that a Full SBS image contains both eyes side by side. This changes output size, not the depth model’s analysis resolution. Leave blank to avoid an explicit width cap.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--metadata:
Requests IW3’s filename-based metadata option. filename is the available choice. This does not improve depth or sharpness. Inject Z renames the final deliverables, so do not rely on this setting to control Inject Z’s final filenames.

Available choices in your installed IW3: filename.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--pad:
Adds a border around the output. Enter a fraction of image width: IW3 calculates the per-side padding as round(width × value) ÷ 2. For example, 0.02 gives roughly 1% of the width per padded side. Pad Mode chooses the sides. This is not an automatic cure for stereo-window violations.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--pad-mode:
Chooses where padding is added: tblr = all sides; tb = top and bottom; lr = left and right; top = top only. 16:9 uses the corresponding aspect-ratio padding mode. Applies with padding settings; it does not improve object-depth recognition.

Available choices in your installed IW3: tblr, tb, lr, 16:9, top.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--resolution:
Size of the depth model’s input, measured along the shorter side in pixels. For example, 512 or 768. Higher values can preserve finer depth-map structure but cost more time and memory; they do not guarantee better outlines. The model may round to its supported dimensions. This does not directly set final output resolution or 3D strength.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--rotate-left:
Rotates the input photo 90 degrees counterclockwise before processing. Enable only when the photo needs that correction. Do not enable both rotation directions.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--rotate-right:
Rotates the input photo 90 degrees clockwise before processing. Enable only when the photo needs that correction. Do not enable both rotation directions.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--stereo-width:
Width in pixels used by supported row_flow stereo-generation models, including row_flow_v2 and row_flow_v3. This controls the stereo synthesis stage separately from Depth Resolution. Larger values may cost more processing and memory. Other methods may ignore it; blank uses IW3’s default.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--synthetic-view:
Chooses which eyes are generated. both modifies both views and shares the work/artifacts between them. right keeps the original as the left view and generates the right. left does the reverse. With one generated eye, that eye has to handle the full separation and may show stronger artifacts. Start with both.

Available choices in your installed IW3: both, right, left.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--tta:
Test-time augmentation: estimates depth with flipped versions of the image and combines the predictions. It can change or improve some estimates, but adds work and is not guaranteed to fix fine hair or outlines. Leave default for speed; compare a sample if testing quality.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--warp-steps:
Number of warping steps for supported stereo methods such as row_flow_v3. Enter a positive whole number. More steps can add work; behavior depends on method and strength. Blank lets IW3 choose its automatic value. This is not a depth-map detail setting.

Blank fields / IW3 default keep the existing default. These controls affect IW3 only.
--method: Chooses how IW3 turns depth into the two eye views. mlbw_l2_inpaint combines warping with hole filling; row_flow variants use learned stereo-generation models; grid_sample/backward use resampling; forward variants project pixels forward, with fill/inpaint variants handling exposed gaps. Other mlbw, mask and sym names are alternate implementations. Their quality and speed vary by image and installed version; there is no universal best. Some methods require matching model weights. Start with the existing method and compare one photo at a time.
--convergence: Moves the depth position of the stereo screen without improving the depth map. Enter 0–1. The visual result depends on the model and Convergence Mode. Higher values generally provide more behind-screen placement in IW3’s convention. Inject Z defaults to 0.25. Test small changes while keeping strength fixed; border protection is a separate control.
--foreground-scale: Redistributes depth between near and far areas. 0 leaves the curve unchanged. Positive values up to 3 emphasize foreground depth and reduce background depth; negative values down to -3 do the reverse. It can help flat-looking people in outdoor scenes. It does not make the model identify edges or hair more accurately.
--preserve-screen-border: Uses IW3’s experimental border-preservation treatment. Enabled when checked, provided Allow Window Violations is off. It adjusts depth behavior at image borders but is not a guarantee that every foreground object stays behind the stereo window. Inject Z’s separate window protection also matters.
--depth-aa: Depth anti-aliasing reduces jagged structure along depth-map boundaries on supported models. Checked enables it; unchecked leaves it off. It may add processing and does not identify missing fine details or repair an incorrect depth estimate. Unsupported models may ignore it.
